name: IRONWALL CONTINENTAL: Chrome Combat Football S4
description: The premier full-contact football league where augmentation limits were abolished in 2189, resulting in athletes capable of 60 kph sprints, titanium-reinforced tackles, and subdermal impact absorption. Sponsored by Meridian Synthesis Group and broadcast across all corporate feeds, the league draws massive viewership from Tiers 2-5 with legal betting markets generating hundreds of millions of Φ annually. Season 4 introduced the Cascade Rule, banning neural reflex overclocking mid-play after three fatalities in Season 3.
story_hooks: A Tier 2 athlete who can't afford the chrome upgrades her competitors have discovers an illegal underground augmentation surgeon willing to work on credit — with interest paid in favors.

A player survives a career-ending spinal injury and, rather than accepting the league's standard payout, goes public with internal documents proving the Cascade Rule was created to protect corporate liability, not players.
A sports journalist embedded with a corporate team uncovers that two rival franchises have been sharing injury data to identify and target the opposing team's weakest structural augmentations.
